evals.name: basic-training-script
evals.prompt: Write a Python script to train PatchCore on the MVTecAD bottle category for 3 epochs.
evals.expected_output: Creates MVTecAD datamodule with category='bottle', instantiates Patchcore model, creates Engine with max_epochs=3, and calls engine.fit(model=model, datamodule=datamodule).
expectations: Imports from anomalib.data, anomalib.models, and anomalib.engine
Creates Engine(max_epochs=3) passing trainer kwargs directly

evals.name: custom-folder-training
evals.prompt: I have normal images in ./data/good/ and defect images in ./data/bad/ with masks in ./data/masks/. Train Padim on this data.
evals.expected_output: Uses Folder datamodule with name, root, normal_dir='good', abnormal_dir='bad', mask_dir='masks', then trains with Engine.fit().
expectations: Sets normal_dir='good' and abnormal_dir='bad' and mask_dir='masks'
Provides the required name parameter to Folder

evals.name: cli-training
evals.prompt: What's the CLI command to train Padim on MVTecAD transistor category with 5 max epochs?
expectations: Overrides epochs via --trainer.max_epochs 5 (not a custom Trainer object)

evals.name: engine-kwargs-pattern
evals.prompt: How do I configure the training accelerator and devices in anomalib?
evals.expected_output: Pass Lightning Trainer kwargs directly to Engine(): Engine(accelerator='gpu', devices=1). For Intel XPU, use Engine(strategy=SingleXPUStrategy(), accelerator=XPUAccelerator()).
expectations: Passes accelerator/devices as kwargs to Engine() directly
Does not construct a separate Trainer object
Mentions SingleXPUStrategy and XPUAccelerator for Intel XPU

evals.name: negative-training-free-model
evals.prompt: Padim doesn't use gradient descent. Do I need special code to handle its training differently?
evals.expected_output: No — training-free models still go through engine.fit(). Engine/Trainer handles the single epoch needed to build their memory bank. No special-case code needed.
expectations: States training-free models still use engine.fit() normally
Explains Trainer handles the single epoch for memory bank building
Does not suggest any special-case code or skipping fit()
